def: A rightholder’s statement, for online content in machine-readable form, that excludes their works from the EU’s general text-and-data-mining exception under Article 4(3) of Directive 2019/790.
practice: Expressed through robots.txt rules, metadata, terms of service or protocols such as TDMRep; crawlers gathering training data for the EU market need to detect and record these opt-outs.
